# Premium workspace

13 October 2026. Retains the user's charcoal/red Arcane reference, with restrained system-sans typography, quiet navigation, a focused conversation and progressive disclosure.

- One centered onboarding surface; no duplicate welcome card or always-visible technical panel.
- Native modal Settings drawer, keyboard focus containment, Escape/backdrop close, opener focus restoration and secret dismissal.
- Compact Tools menu; selection/outside click/Escape close it without changing conversations or submitting.
- Normal-font public message text and collapsed scope/acknowledgement details. Uncertain actions and complete approval scopes remain visible; nothing auto-grants or retries.
- Plain-language confirmed progress; healthy byte counter retained for assistive technology rather than visible terminal-style telemetry.
- Responsive short/mobile layouts, reduced-motion and forced-colors support.
